name: singing_dunes
theme: a dune sea at deep dusk under the shredded rings of a broken moon — two wave trains cross at every scale, from ranked crescent dunes down a slip face to a heap of grains where every grain is a different mineral, into one clear grain's growth terraces and its crossed plane fringes, which open straight back out into the ranked grooves of the ring plane and fall home onto the dune world

registers.name: dune_sea
registers.palette: cold violet shadow and pale sienna
registers.scene: a dune sea at deep dusk from high above, rank on rank of crescent dunes standing in two sets that cross at a shallow angle across the whole plain, pale flats between the ranks, every slip face ruled with fine ripple lines, long violet shadows drawn out from each crest, a bright arc of moon rubble low across the far sky
registers.target: a tall crescent dune, its ridge bright

registers.name: dune_country
registers.palette: hot rose-gold and deep plum shade
registers.scene: a country of great crescent dunes from low in the air, one broad slip face standing over a pale flat, two sets of ripple ranks crossing at a shallow angle down its whole flank, diamond cells standing bright where the sets overlap, a thin haze of lifted sand along the ridges, more dunes ranked away into violet distance

registers.name: crest_line
registers.palette: cool violet-grey with a bright sienna edge
registers.scene: a long sand ridge at standing height, its bright crest line running away into the dusk, two ripple trains crossing over the flank at a shallow angle, diamond cells standing where they meet, pale fans of loose sand down the steep side, cold violet shadow pooled along the base, further ridges ranked beyond

registers.name: ripple_field
registers.scene: a corrugated plain of sand ripples at ground level, low parallel ridges in two sets crossing at a shallow angle, bright sienna ridge tops and violet troughs between them, broad light and dark bands standing where the two sets beat against each other, coarse grains banked in bright drifts along every ridge

registers.name: grain_heap
registers.palette: garnet red, amber, green and water-clear on violet shadow
registers.scene: a bank of rounded sand grains packed together, every grain a different mineral, deep red garnet beside amber zircon beside green olivine beside water-clear quartz beside black magnetite, each one frosted and pitted, violet shadow held in the hollows between them, more grains banked away in every direction

registers.name: grain_body
registers.palette: pale frost white and cold lilac
registers.scene: a world of clear quartz seen from just above its frosted ground, shallow scalloped cups over the whole terrain, bright rims where the cups meet, two sets of hair-thin fractures crossing the frost in long straight runs, dark violet gaps out to the neighbouring grains beyond

registers.name: grain_interior
registers.palette: rose-gold and honey banding on soft violet
registers.scene: a world of clear stone, wide banded growth zones stacked one on the next in rose-gold and honey, fine straight inclusions running through the pale layers in two crossing sets, bright edges where a layer steps out over the one below, depth on depth of further layers beyond

registers.name: growth_terraces
registers.palette: pale green-white and cold blue shadow
registers.scene: a plain of growth terraces inside the crystal, straight ledges one layer high running in long parallel ranks, a second set of ranks crossing them at a shallow angle, wide glassy treads between, pale green-white light lying flat over the whole plain, broad soft bands standing where the two sets overlap
registers.target: a bright lattice node, sharp and glowing

registers.name: crystal_planes
registers.palette: pale rose-gold lines on deep violet black
registers.scene: ranks of glowing lattice planes standing in the dark, two sets of straight bright lines crossing at a shallow angle, broad pale fringe bands blooming where the sets overlap, a bright point at every crossing, rank behind rank into deep violet dark

registers.name: ring_system
registers.palette: bone-white bands on violet black with an ochre centre
registers.scene: the shredded ring plane of a broken moon from high above it, thousands of narrow bright bands ranked one inside the next, two spiral wave trains crossing them and standing in broad light and dark grooves, a wide black gap cut clean through the ranks, an ochre planet small at the centre, faint stars in the deep violet beyond

registers.name: planet
registers.palette: burnt sienna and rose-gold on deep violet
registers.scene: an ochre desert world at dusk seen from orbit, its whole day side ruled with fine parallel dune grain, ranked bright bands of moon rubble crossing the view in one wide flat plane, the shadow of those bands laid in dark stripes across the dune grain, a thin rose-gold air line along the curve, faint stars in the deep violet beyond
registers.loop_target: an ochre desert world at dusk seen from orbit, its day side ruled with fine dune grain, ranked bright bands of moon rubble crossing in one flat plane, faint stars beyond

music_theme: dry warm air over a cooling desert — low sustained drone and slow sand-shaker pulses under airy pads, the pulse doubling as the dive tightens onto the grains, one wide bright bloom where the crossed crystal planes open into the ring plane, settling back to the drone on the fall home
